title: RESIDE ITS scene-level source exclusion qualification
rationale: The current Haze4K continuous-utility route has never used ITS outcomes for selection, but that fact alone does not make all ITS scenes unseen by the Haze4K checkpoint. This source-identity-only route audits every canonical Haze4K source group against every ITS clear scene with a frozen multi-view matcher and conservative family exclusion. It publishes an exact reusable exclusion list only if all 500 provenance-expected indoor source relationships are recovered while positive and negative controls pass. No model, inference, outcome metric, threshold tuning, or protected data is used.

orthogonal_changes.reason: This route changes from Haze4K measurement qualification to source-identity qualification for the independent RESIDE ITS synthetic-indoor target domain.

scientific_contract.question: Can a frozen full-census matcher identify every provenance-expected indoor Haze4K source relationship in RESIDE ITS, conservatively exclude all accepted ITS source families, and leave enough independent ITS clear scenes for a separately frozen unseen-domain measurement?

intervention.reference: all 1,000 canonical Haze4K clear-source groups and every official ITS clear scene
intervention.matched_budget: full deterministic census with fixed seven views, top-64 retrieval, fixed score gates, bidirectional matching, and no result-adaptive extension
fixed_factors: Haze4K 4,000 GT files grouped by decoded 64x64 RGB canonical digest into exactly 1,000 source scenes
ITS train and validation clear scenes kept as separate named assets but searched jointly
seven fixed full and crop views
forward and reverse correlation floor 0.98 and score-gap floor 0.005
accepted candidate families expanded by exact canonical identity or pHash distance zero with correlation at least 0.995
all 1,000 fixed resize-plus-JPEG Haze4K identity controls must recover their original canonical source at top 64 and top one
SOTS-outdoor scenes act as negative controls for admission to ITS
500 indoor source relationships are required; a lower count is a method-specific FAIL, not proof that overlap is absent

primary_estimand.metric: number of canonical Haze4K source groups receiving an accepted bidirectional ITS source relationship under the frozen matcher
primary_estimand.aggregation: deterministic full-census count over canonical clear-source groups

controls: qualified RESIDE layout hashes and all frozen directory counts
exact Haze4K canonical-group count and four-alias grouping
top-64 and top-one recovery of every fixed transformed Haze4K identity control
zero accepted ITS mappings among all 492 SOTS-outdoor negative controls
one-to-one forward and reverse nearest-neighbour checks
explicit statement that matcher failure is not an infeasibility certificate

uncertainty.method: deterministic full-population identity audit; integrity decisions use exact census counts and nested views never increase independent n

gates.estimand: frozen RESIDE hashes, 11,000 ITS clear scenes, 4,000 Haze4K GT files, and 492 SOTS-outdoor controls match
1,000 canonical Haze4K source groups with four aliases each
proportion of fixed transformed Haze4K identity controls whose original source is present in top 64
proportion of fixed transformed Haze4K identity controls recovering the original source at top one
proportion of 492 SOTS-outdoor controls rejected by ITS acceptance
ITS clear scenes remaining after conservative family exclusion

scientific_contract.competing_explanation: ITS and Haze4K source images may differ by crop, resize, compression, color transform, or near-duplicate family membership beyond the frozen global matcher. A FAIL therefore identifies a limitation of this method, not proof that no safe ITS pool exists.
disabled_actions: training, inference, dehazing evaluation, or metric computation on model outputs
using ITS, Haze4K, OTS, or SOTS images as outcome evidence
adapting views, top-k, thresholds, family expansion, controls, or matching rules after results
claiming absence of source overlap or mapping infeasibility from a matcher FAIL
combining future ITS scenes with Haze4K scenes as one target population
ITS measurement execution before a PASS closeout

precision_contract.rationale: The operation observes the complete 1,000-group Haze4K source census and all 11,000 ITS clear scenes; identity and capacity decisions use exact counts rather than sampling intervals.

capability.production_path_statement: The CPU contract executes the exact multi-view pHash candidate-order implementation at the full 1,000-query by 11,000-candidate work scale with seven views and top-64 selection, without reading scientific data.

precision.source_reference: Worst-case Bernoulli standard deviation 0.5; the route observes all 1,000 canonical Haze4K source groups.
